name: accounting-software
description: AI-first, source-available double-entry accounting for SMB to enterprise.
//license: FSL-1.1-ALv2. Not an SPDX identifier, so npm's convention is the SEE LICENSE IN form.

scripts.//db: DATABASE_URL points these at any Postgres -- the Compose one, an embedded desktop instance, or a scratch database. Compose no longer applies any schema itself; the migration runner owns that.
scripts.//db:migrate: Applies pending migrations. Safe to re-run: it is a no-op when up to date, and refuses on drift.
scripts.//db:roles: Creates the nl_query role with a dev-only secret. Separate from migrations because the password differs per install and must not live in a committed file.
scripts.db:apply: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:roles
scripts.db:verify: for f in verify_schema verify_roles verify_currency verify_rls; do psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "db/$f.sql" || exit 1; done
scripts.//db:snapshot: Regenerates the committed db/schema.sql from a fully migrated database. Run after adding a migration and commit the result.
scripts.api:install: pip install -e packages/ai && pip install -e packages/api[dev]
